meaning: Study identifier for one congress presentation
derivation: sprintf("AAGL%d_%03d", congress_year, row_number()) over the filtered supplement listing, in page order

meaning: Calendar year of the AAGL Global Congress
derivation: Assigned from the congress whose supplement URL produced the row

meaning: Presentation title as printed in the supplement
derivation: str_remove(title, "^[0-9]+\\s+[-–]\\s*") strips session-number prefixes used by 2013/2017/2018/2021

meaning: First listed AAGL author as LastName + first initial
derivation: normalize_author() on element 1 of the comma-split author list

meaning: Last listed AAGL author as LastName + first initial
derivation: normalize_author() on the final element; forced NA when the listing was truncated with an ellipsis
missing_meaning: NA when ScienceDirect truncated the author list, so the visible last name is not the senior author
notes: 69.3% coverage because truncation is common.

meaning: Number of authors visible in the ScienceDirect listing
derivation: length of the comma-split author list after credential and digit stripping
missing_meaning: never missing (0 when the string was empty)
notes: CENSORED AT 5. ScienceDirect truncates author lists, so this is not the true author count.

meaning: Randomized design detected in the abstract text
derivation: str_detect on abstract_design or search_text for randomi[sz]ed|rct|random\\s+alloc
notes: Derived from title only for 2012-2018; see FAILURE_MODES.md F3.

meaning: Reported number of subjects
derivation: first n=/N=/total of/included capture, else the largest 2-5 digit number that is not a year
missing_meaning: no numeric pattern found in the available text

meaning: Academic-centre affiliation detected
derivation: str_detect for university|academic|teaching hospital|school of medicine|tertiary.*center|residency|fellowship
notes: affiliation_raw is NA at the time this runs, so it is text-only. 0-4% in 2012-2018 vs 22-47% later.

meaning: US location detected
derivation: str_detect against state names/abbreviations and a list of major US cities and institutions
notes: 31-45% in 2012-2018 vs 97-100% in 2019-2023; a text-availability artefact, not a real trend.

meaning: AAGL programme section the presentation appeared under
derivation: Nearest preceding h3.section-title in DOM order; collapsed to Oral/Video/Poster
notes: Constant Oral in the analytical dataset by construction.

meaning: Twelve-level study design classification
derivation: Ordered case_when in 02_clean_abstracts.R (mirrored by classify_study_design() in R/utils_classify.R); first matching rule wins; falls through to "other"
allowed_values: case_control | case_series | cost_analysis | cross_sectional | other | prospective_cohort | quality_improvement | rct | retrospective_cohort | simulation_lab | systematic_review | validation

meaning: Whether the abstract DESCRIBES the study as multicentre
derivation: str_detect on abstract text for multi-?center|multi-?site|multi-?institutional|N center(s)/site(s)/institution(s)/hospital(s)
notes: A CLAIM MADE IN THE TEXT, not a verified design fact. TRUE for 65 of 1,106. It is not the same as the authors coming from several institutions: 679 abstracts name more than one affiliation, and 58 of the 65 do both, so the two agree where the text is explicit and diverge where it is silent. A two-site study that never uses the word is counted FALSE, so this under-counts multicentre conduct. PI decision, 2026-09-05: retained as the design claim rather than redefined as n_affiliations > 1, which would measure collaboration breadth instead. See appendix A22.

meaning: Funding language detected
derivation: str_detect for funded by|grant|supported by|nih|nichd|foundation|sponsor|funding
notes: <=1% in every year; near-zero variance.

meaning: Inferential statistics reported
derivation: str_detect for p<= 0.|confidence interval|odds ratio|hazard ratio|relative risk|ci with a digit

meaning: Numeric results present in the results or conclusion section
derivation: str_detect for decimals|p<=|OR|HR|RR|percentages|CI
notes: 0% for 2012-2018 by construction: those years have no structured section columns.

meaning: Administrative or national database used
derivation: str_detect for NSQIP|HCUP|NIS|NRD|SEER|NCDB|SART|PUF|Premier|MarketScan|TriNetX and similar

meaning: Named device or pharmaceutical company mentioned
derivation: str_detect against a fixed list of 25 manufacturer names

meaning: Trial registration identifier present
derivation: str_detect for nct\\d{5}|isrctn\\d+|clinicaltrials.gov|trial regist

meaning: Ethics or IRB approval statement present
derivation: str_detect for irb|institutional review board|ethics committee|ethical approval|human subjects

meaning: Words in the abstract full text
derivation: length of the whitespace split of coalesce(abstract_full_text, abstract_text, "")
notes: 0 for every 2012-2018 abstract: computed before the text backfill and never recomputed.

meaning: Whether the raw ScienceDirect author string was visibly elided
derivation: str_detect(authors_raw, '\\.{2,}') — TRUE when the listing ends in an ellipsis
missing_meaning: never missing (FALSE when the string was empty)
notes: Distinguishes a censored author list from a genuinely short one. It is NOT the same signal as the display cap: a flagged row parses to author_count 4, because the ellipsis consumes a slot, while a capped row shows 5 and is not flagged. Counting only author_count >= 5 therefore understates how many listings are incomplete. Computed at 02 and carried through R/05_adjudicate.R deliberately; it had been dropped from that select once, which made author censoring invisible downstream. Pinned by config/data_contract.yml.

meaning: Direction of the abstract's reported findings
source: abstract conclusion, measurements or full text
derivation: classify_result_positivity() in R/utils_positivity.R, applied to the first of abstract_conclusion / abstract_measurements / abstract_full_text / abstract_text that is long enough
missing_meaning: no text field long enough to classify
notes: Restored to the analytical dataset on 2026-09-03; it had been dropped from 05_adjudicate.R's select, which silently disabled the Aim 5 block.

meaning: Seven-level topic classification
derivation: Ordered case_when; basic_science > education > quality_improvement > health_services > device_technology > clinical > other
allowed_values: basic_science | clinical | device_technology | education | health_services | other | quality_improvement

meaning: Most specific surgical procedure named
derivation: Ordered case_when over 11 procedure patterns; most specific rule first; NA when none match
allowed_values: adnexal_surgery | cerclage | ectopic_pregnancy | endometriosis | fibroids | gynecologic_oncology | hysterectomy | myomectomy | pelvic_floor | sacrocolpopexy | sterilization

meaning: PMID of the highest-scoring candidate
derivation: First row of score_details after arrange(desc(total_score))
notes: Ties are broken by candidate order in the pool.

meaning: Composite match score of the best candidate
derivation: Sum of the ten score components; see MATCHING_ALGORITHM.md
notes: Observed range -1.29 to 13.00; theoretical range -5 to 14.

meaning: Algorithmic match tier
derivation: classify_match(): excluded > definite > probable > possible > no_match; ties demote definite to probable; no_candidates set upstream
allowed_values: definite | excluded | no_candidates | no_match | possible | probable

meaning: Two candidates share the top score
derivation: total_score[1] == total_score[2]
notes: Compares only the top two rows.

meaning: Candidates scored for this abstract
derivation: nrow(candidates_df) for this abstract
notes: Sums to 64718, more than the 48984 rows now in pubmed_candidates.csv.

meaning: Jaccard word-token similarity of the two titles
derivation: jaccard_similarity(abstract title, candidate title)

meaning: Title-similarity points
Abstract-similarity points
derivation: 2 if >=0.70, 1 if >=0.50, else 0; requires both texts >20 characters
notes: Always 0 for 2017 and 2018 abstracts in the current data.

meaning: First-author match points
derivation: 2 for an exact normalized match; 1 for Jaro-Winkler >= 0.95; else 0

meaning: Last-author match points
derivation: 2 exact; 1 for Jaro-Winkler >= 0.95; else 0
notes: Always 0 when the AAGL author list was truncated.

meaning: Coauthor overlap points
derivation: 1 when >= 2 normalized names appear in both lists

meaning: Author-team bonus
derivation: 1 when coauthor_pts == 1 and first_au_pts >= 1

meaning: Journal-relevance points
derivation: Maximum Jaro-Winkler similarity to a fixed list of 12 OB/GYN journal names
notes: Continuous 0-1; awards partial credit to every journal, including unrelated ones.

meaning: Keyword-overlap points
derivation: 1 when >= 3 keywords intersect
notes: INERT: 0 for all 1102 scored abstracts. Abstract keywords are TF tokens; PubMed keywords are MeSH-style phrases, so they never intersect.

meaning: Publication-timing points
derivation: pre_conference_penalty (-3) if before the congress; 1 if <= 18 months after; 0.5 if <= 30 months; else 0

meaning: No-text-evidence penalty
derivation: -2 when title_pts == 0 and title_sim < 0.20 and abstract_pts == 0

meaning: Title of the matched publication
derivation: left_join on best_pmid; blanked for no_match, no_candidates and possible

notes: Only 137 of 1106 populated; 74 published abstracts have no publication metadata. See FAILURE_MODES.md F2.

meaning: Journal of the matched publication

meaning: Publication year of the matched publication
derivation: as pub_title
